reviews.text: Simply the best groomer I've ever had. I moved out of Paris, and since then I've tried four others, who are all good, but Pimprenelle is still far superior. I'm in Paris these days, and I'm going to take the opportunity to book an appointment.
Very professional, you can tell she loves animals, I'm very happy with her services and my dogs are too.
Celine is not only a trusted professional, she is also loving and caring - everything that we can hope for our four-legged family member 🐶 highly recommended🌟 …
Our favorite groomer, thank you for always taking such good care of Romeo ❤️ See you very soon!

Fantastic grooming salon! Céline is an exceptional groomer, very welcoming and accommodating. She even agreed to take my puppy before opening time so he'd be all spruced up for the holidays! Can't wait to go back!

At Primprenelle, our dogs are pampered by fairy-like hands. I highly recommend them for the quality of their work and the lifelong love of animals that Céline has always had.

Our groomer forever ❤️
Isabelle, M’as tu vu, and Marcus

Céline is a lovely person who loves animals! She's the only one who can take care of my rather temperamental dog. He always leaves looking impeccable, his coat stays well-groomed for weeks. I highly recommend this salon! A thousand thanks :) Sébastien and Fidji :)

My Yorkie, Arthur, has been getting groomed at Pimprenelle's since I adopted him three years ago, and we wouldn't go anywhere else! Céline is a magician at her craft, and she's also lovely, welcoming, smiling, and accommodating. The dogs clearly feel comfortable with her; they don't hesitate to go, and they leave not only perfectly groomed but happy! Thank you!
I have trusted Céline with my dog ​​Pépito for 6 years.

Céline is a very attentive, reassuring, and gentle person.

I highly recommend this salon!

What can I say about Céline? 🤔 She's the kind of person we wish we saw more often.
Kind, friendly, and she knows her stuff. My little dog Scarlet 🐕
adores her ❤️
I highly recommend her without hesitation.
Thank you, Céline!
No new clients are accepted unfortunately 💔 …

What a joke! Don't bother coming, madam isn't taking any new clients!
In a haughty tone, she told me, "I don't take walk-ins, I'm with my clients." But who says I'm just passing through? Everyone has to start somewhere... This kind of thinking is astonishing... on their website, they invite us to come and meet her... Disappointing...

New update: They're not taking any more cats for the time being, it seems :( It's a shame because I haven't found anything better yet...

UPDATE 2 years later:
Still just as delighted! My Oracio is always well cared for. Céline is a gem, always so attentive. Her apprentice, Léa, is just as friendly. My Oracio is so soft, as usual, after every visit to Pimprenelle (photo). Thank you ♡ ^^
I totally recommend them! However, if you want to make an appointment, you have to book in advance, as they have many clients :)

I am completely satisfied!
My little Oracio arrived a bit unkempt and came out looking beautiful and clean ❤️ Céline is lovely and immediately puts you at ease with her cheerful disposition. It was my little guy's second grooming session, but his very first at Pimprenelle. It was also his first real bath, and I was pleasantly surprised! ^^ She took great care of my Oracio, reassured him; it went very well. He smells lovely, and his fur is so soft. Pimprenelle will be his go-to groomer from now on.
Thanks again, Céline!
